name: Pike
title: The Rookery's Eyes
examine: Perched on a crate with a whittling knife and a view of everything. The whittling never seems to produce anything. The view does.
lines: You came up the alley. Everyone comes up the alley the first time. The interesting ones leave by the ledge.
Two whistles means watch. One means friendly. You got one. Don't make me revise it.
The Undercroft stair's behind the arch. Mab's people keep the braziers fed. We use it more than the miners ever did.
